description: This file implements the CompositionManager class for handling display composition, overlay parsing, frame processing, and blending in a graphics or display subsystem, specifically within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It manages shared memory buffers, overlays, and frame blending for display outputs.

classes.name: CompositionManager
classes.description: Manages display composition, overlay parsing, frame blending, and shared memory buffers for display outputs within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: DisplayOverlay
classes.description: Represents overlay configuration for display composition, including source VM and display indices.

classes.name: LastFrameInfo
classes.description: Stores information about the last frame processed for a display, including dimensions, format, and buffer pointers.

methods.name: alpha_blend_layer
methods.description: Performs alpha blending of an overlay onto a frame buffer.

methods.name: ParseOverlays
methods.description: Parses overlay configuration strings into structured overlay data.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a CompositionManager object, initializing overlays and configuration.

methods.name: OnDisplayCreated
methods.description: Handles display creation events, initializing shared memory buffers.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Processes each frame, updating shared buffers and blending overlays.

methods.name: ComposeFrame
methods.description: Forces a display to refresh its composition, blending overlays as needed.

methods.name: AlphaBlendLayers
methods.description: Blends configured overlay layers over the base frame pixels.

methods.name: ComposeFrame (overloaded)
methods.description: Performs composition of a frame, converting to I420 format for display.
